About Apply

APPLY is the Agentic Customer Experience (ACx) partner for the world's most ambitious consumer and entertainment brands. We bring together deep domain expertise across Retail, CPG, Sports, and Media with AI-native delivery capability, designing and delivering agentic solutions that turn CX vision into commercial reality. We are the partner of choice for brands like Arc'teryx, NFL, Lululemon, and Kraft Heinz. For more information, visit applydigital.com .

LOCATION:
APPLY is hybrid/remote friendly. The preferred candidate should be based in Canada, working in hours that align to ET (Eastern Timezone)
.

THE ROLE:

We are seeking a Program Director who combines a deep background in digital agency delivery, executive client partnership, and hands-on AI/agentic leadership. In this role, you will lead high-impact digital transformation programs, cultivate trusted C-suite relationships, and drive modern, AI-enabled delivery practices across cross-functional teams. An understanding of manufacturing environments, including plant operations, R&D, and product development, will set you apart when working with our client in this sector.

Responsibilities

Client Expectation Management: Proactively communicate project status, potential risks, and changes to client stakeholders, ensuring alignment of expectations and fostering strong client relationships. This includes providing input and updates to senior leaders in accordance with the overarching program governance and working with PMO and workstream leads to ensure programs remain aligned to corporate strategies and top-down imperatives.
Account Strategy & Growth: Develop and execute actionable client account plans to drive organic account growth and support regional growth targets. Collaborate closely with Business Development to support new business efforts within the region or portfolio. Share accountability for account revenue, profitability, and client satisfaction.
Client Advocacy & Partnership: Position the firm as a strategic partner and trusted advisor to our most senior clients. Ensure that our client’s needs, priorities, and goals are clearly and effectively communicated to the program and delivery teams, providing overall account leadership.
Successful Delivery: Oversee the end-to-end delivery of programs and projects, ensuring they meet scope, budget, and timeline requirements while maintaining high-quality standards. This involves defining and implementing custom program governance mechanisms, establishing strategies and plans with metrics of success, and driving priorities and task assignments.
Agentic & AI-Enabled Delivery Leadership: Guide client and internal adoption of Gemini Enterprise and agentic delivery methods, defining review gates, human-in-the-loop governance, reusable prompts/skills, automated workflows, and value metrics to elevate delivery efficiency across the discipline.

Requirements

Program Delivery & Client Services Experience

10+ years leading end-to-end digital delivery in consulting or agency environments for enterprise clients.
Proven track record in client services and account management, building C-suite relationships and driving account growth.
Experience managing multi-track programs or portfolios with $7-10M+ annual financial responsibility, diverse stakeholders, and competing priorities.
Strong commercial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, proposal estimates, and scoping multi-million dollar engagements.
Expertise in Agile, Kanban, Waterfall, and agentic delivery frameworks across the full software development lifecycle.
Proficiency with AI tools (Gemini, Claude) and modern project management software (JIRA, Confluence, Smartsheet, Workspace).
Previous experience as a Strategist, Business Analyst, Technologist, or another role that contributed directly to digital project deliverables.

Manufacturing Experience

Experience consulting or working within B2B manufacturing environments, with a strong understanding of plant-level operations and engineering systems to drive digital and AI opportunities.
Proven track record supporting innovation, R&D, or product development functions.

Communication & Soft Skills

Communication Excellence: Exceptional written and verbal communication, tailored across audiences from steering committees to delivery teams with clarity and transparency.
Influence & Gravitas: Able to lead, advise, and sell, with the gravitas to influence C-level executives, with a high degree of independence and autonomy in decision-making.
Interpersonal Intelligence: High emotional intelligence, navigating conflict with empathy, practicing compassionate candor, and influencing stakeholders without formal authority.
Sound Judgment: Experience-based judgment to guide teams, address complex challenges, and make sound business decisions balancing client satisfaction, profitability, quality, and team cohesion.

AI & Agentic Delivery

As APPLY operates on an agentic model, hands-on AI fluency is essential. You will use these tools daily, coach others in them, and lead discussions about agentic workflows with clients and internal teams.

Hands-on experience with Claude and Gemini (Gemini Enterprise), is strongly preferred.

A passion for AI with a commitment to continuous growth, experimentation, and guiding teams and clients through evolving ways of working.

Familiarity with BMAD, Markdown, CLI AI tools (e.g., Claude Code), and MCP connectors is a bonus.

$160,000 - $200,000 a year

About Us

At BGBx
, we're driven by a simple idea: breakthrough thinking creates breakthrough impact. As an independent commercial solutions partner to pharmaceutical and life science companies, we bring together strategists, scientists, communicators, creatives, technologists, and data experts to tackle some of healthcare's most important challenges.

Our teams work across consulting and communications to help clients shape strategy, launch innovations, engage stakeholders, and drive meaningful results throughout the product lifecycle. The work is complex, fast-moving, and deeply connected to improving lives, creating opportunities for curious minds to make a real difference every day.

If you're energized by collaboration, inspired by innovation, and motivated by work that matters, you'll find a place to grow, contribute, and make a meaningful impact at BGBx.

Position Overview

The VP, Engagement Strategy turns brand strategy into connected omnichannel engagement.
This senior leader defines how audience insight, behavioral science, content, media, CRM, field engagement, technology, and measurement work together across the customer journey. The VP leads clients and integrated teams from insight through activation and optimization, while helping grow BGBx's Engagement Strategy capability.

Key Responsibilities

Engagement & Omnichannel Strategy

Lead audience-centered, behaviorally informed omnichannel strategies across HCP, patient, caregiver, payer, and other stakeholder audiences
Translate brand and business strategy into connected journeys, engagement architectures, channel roles, sequencing, triggers, and activation roadmaps
Define how content, media, CRM, field, social, experiential, and digital interactions work together to move audiences toward desired behaviors
Make clear strategic choices and tradeoffs that focus investment on the moments and interactions most likely to create impact

Audience, Content & Experience

Turn research, segmentation, behavioral data, cultural context, and market dynamics into actionable audience understanding
Identify the beliefs, motivations, barriers, decision pathways, and moments of receptivity that engagement must address
Shape content and experience strategy so each interaction has a clear role, purpose, call to action, and connection to what happens next
Maintain the strategic throughline as work moves from strategy into creative development, implementation, and optimization

Measurement & Optimization

Define engagement objectives, KPI frameworks, signal plans, and learning agendas
Design closed-loop approaches that use customer response and performance data to improve content, channels, sequencing, and future engagement
Turn performance findings into clear strategic implications and optimization recommendations

Client, Growth & Team Leadership

Serve as a trusted strategic partner to senior clients and lead executive presentations, workshops, and high-stakes strategic conversations
Lead engagement and omnichannel strategy for pitches, organic growth opportunities, and capability development
Manage, mentor, and develop strategists while raising the quality, consistency, and visibility of BGBx's Engagement Strategy offering

Qualifications

10+ years of relevant experience across engagement strategy, omnichannel strategy, experience planning, digital strategy, CRM strategy, integrated strategy, or related disciplines

Proven ability to lead complex engagement strategy from audience insight and problem definition through activation, measurement, and optimization
Strong understanding of HCP and patient journeys and the strategic roles of media, CRM, digital, social, field engagement, data, analytics, experience design, and marketing technology
Fluency in how personalization, marketing automation, modular content, next-best action, and decisioning can support omnichannel engagement
Strong client leadership, facilitation, executive communication, and strategic storytelling skills
Experience leading pitches, growing client relationships, and managing or developing strategists
Working knowledge of pharmaceutical regulatory, privacy, consent, and compliance considerations

Preferred Experience

Experience across both HCP and patient engagement and across launch, growth, or mature brand challenges
Experience translating global strategy into locally relevant engagement approaches
Practical experience with advanced segmentation, dynamic personalization, closed-loop marketing, or AI-enabled planning and optimization
Experience building or evolving an engagement, omnichannel, digital, or experience strategy capability

Candidates will be invited to discuss two anonymized examples of work they personally led, including one demonstrating end-to-end omnichannel strategy. We are most interested in problem framing, strategic choices, cross-functional leadership, measurement, and impact. Confidential client information and unpaid speculative work are not required.

Salary is only one component of the total rewards package offered at BGBx.

What We Offer

At BGBx, we invest in our people because exceptional talent drives exceptional work. We provide a competitive rewards package designed to support your health, well-being, professional growth, and life outside of work.

Our benefits package for full-time employees typically includes health care insurance, retirement plans, generous paid time off and holidays, wellness benefits, life insurance, learning and development opportunities, and other resources that support our employees throughout their careers. jobs.title: Chef de l'ingénierie | Head of Engineering
jobs.description:
Description

ABOUT VALPAY

Founded in 2022, ValPay is an all-in-one payment solution tailored to empower its partners' software platforms. Designed for ambitious business owners wanting to focus on growing their business rather than the logistics needed to run it, ValPay helps companies prevent fraud, gain access to real-time reporting, and accept both online and in-person payments. ValPay's PayFac-as-a-Service model gives its partners all the benefits of integrated payments while handling the heavy lifting.

ValPay is a subsidiary of Valsoft.

THE ROLE

As Head of Engineering, you will own the engineering organization at ValPay — how it is structured, how it delivers, and how good it gets. You will report to the CEO and work alongside product and go-to-market leadership to turn a talented, lean team into a predictable, high-performing engineering function.

This is a build role, not a caretaker role. ValPay's engineering team has grown quickly and now needs someone to put real operating discipline behind it: a delivery rhythm people can count on, a management layer that holds, and technical standards that let the platform scale with the business — without losing the speed and hands-on energy that got ValPay here.

We are hiring for trajectory. This role is scoped as Head of Engineering today, and it is designed as the potential path to Chief Technology Officer at ValPay. We would rather hire someone with the ceiling to grow into that seat and back them properly than hire the title and hope. What earns the step up is straightforward: a delivery organization that runs without heroics, a leadership bench you built, and a track record of technical judgment the CEO and the board can lean on.

What You'll Do

Own engineering delivery end to end — planning, execution, release cadence, and quality — and make it predictable enough that the business can plan around it.
Build and lead the engineering management layer: hire, develop, and coach engineering managers, tech leads, and senior/staff engineers, and put a durable structure beneath you.
Partner with Product on roadmap feasibility, sequencing, and trade-offs. Product sets the what; you own the how and the when.
Set and enforce technical standards across the platform — architecture, code quality, testing, observability, and documentation — so the system scales as GMV and merchant count grow.
Serve as the senior technical escalation point for integrations with core payments partners (Adyen, Fiserv), working complex issues to resolution and feeding what you learn back into the platform.
Drive AI adoption inside engineering — in the SDLC, in developer productivity, and in the product where it measurably improves outcomes.
Own engineering operations and reliability: on-call, incident response, postmortems, and the SLAs a PCI DSS Level 1 payments platform has to hold.
Partner with security and compliance to keep PCI DSS certification and multi-jurisdiction obligations met as the platform expands.
Be a steady presence under pressure, and build the organizational muscle for the team to handle incidents increasingly without you.

What You Bring

8+ years in software engineering, including 4+ years leading engineering teams, with at least some of that time managing managers or tech leads.
Proven experience building, structuring, and scaling technology organizations, ideally in high-growth environments.
Experience hiring and developing engineering leaders, and the appetite to keep doing it.
You can still apply hands-on technical depth, you review architecture, you can go deep in a design review or an incident, and engineers respect your judgment. You are not expected to write production code day to day.
Strong judgment on build-versus-buy, technical debt, and where to spend engineering capacity — and the ability to explain those calls in business terms to a non-technical executive team.
A track record of installing delivery process in a fast-moving team without killing its speed: planning cadence, release discipline, on-call, and the metrics to know whether it is working.
Demonstrable ambition and ceiling. You want the CTO seat eventually and you can show what you have been doing to get ready for it.

NICE TO HAVE

Payments, fintech, or other regulated/high-availability environments (PCI DSS, SOC 2, or similar).

Experience in a high-growth or private-equity-backed environment, or integrating engineering teams from acquisitions.

Experience with multi-tenant platform or API-first product architecture.

What Success Looks Like

In the first six to twelve months:

A management layer is in place: engineering managers or tech leads owning their areas, with clear scope and accountability.
Engineering runs on a delivery rhythm the business can plan against — commitments are made and met, and slippage is visible early rather than at the deadline.
Delivery and reliability are measured, not felt — baseline metrics exist for throughput, lead time, change failure rate, and incident response, and they are trending the right way.
AI is in real use inside engineering, with live use cases rather than pilots.
On-call and incident response are defined and drilled, and incidents are increasingly resolved without you in the room.
Technical standards and architecture direction are written down, agreed, and actually followed.

WHY VALPAY

Founded in 2022, ValPay is already operating at scale: a PCI DSS Level 1 certified platform running across 40+ jurisdictions in North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific, serving vertical software platforms in dental, marine, property management, automotive, and more.

Growth runs on three engines, and all three run on the same platform:

Internal sales — converting existing Valsoft GMV to ValPay, a $15B+ opportunity across the current customer base plus every new Valsoft acquisition.
External ISV channel — signing ISVs outside the Valsoft portfolio, $25M–$50M in revenue, with $2B+ in deals already closed and now being converted into live, processing merchants.
M&A engine — acquiring payment gateway businesses, two closed so far, with the same conversion playbook applied to each newly acquired asset.

Embedded payments inside a portfolio of 150+ vertical software companies is distribution most payments companies spend years trying to build. ValPay already has it. What decides how fast these engines scale is the engineering organization behind them — which is the mandate of this role.

ValPay is backed by Valsoft, which buys and holds companies indefinitely rather than selling them. You build on a long horizon, not toward an exit.

For more information: https://www.valpay.com/

___________________________________________________________________________________________

À PROPOS DE VALPAY

Fondée en 2022, ValPay est une solution de paiement tout-en-un conçue pour outiller les plateformes logicielles de ses partenaires. Pensée pour les entrepreneurs ambitieux qui souhaitent se consacrer à la croissance de leur entreprise plutôt qu'à la logistique nécessaire à son exploitation, ValPay aide les entreprises à prévenir la fraude, à accéder à des rapports en temps réel et à accepter les paiements en ligne comme en personne. Le modèle de facilitation des paiements en tant que service (PayFac-as-a-Service) de ValPay procure à ses partenaires tous les avantages des paiements intégrés, tout en prenant en charge le gros du travail.

ValPay est une filiale de Valsoft.

LE POSTE

À titre de chef de l'ingénierie, vous prendrez en charge l'organisation d'ingénierie de ValPay : sa structure, sa capacité de livraison et son niveau d'excellence. Vous relèverez du chef de la direction et travaillerez aux côtés des responsables du produit et de la mise en marché afin de transformer une équipe talentueuse et restreinte en une fonction d'ingénierie prévisible et très performante.

Il s'agit d'un rôle de bâtisseur, et non de gestionnaire de statu quo. L'équipe d'ingénierie de ValPay a connu une croissance rapide et a maintenant besoin d'une personne capable d'y instaurer une véritable discipline opérationnelle : une cadence de livraison fiable, une couche de gestion solide et des normes techniques permettant à la plateforme d'évoluer au rythme de l'entreprise — sans perdre la rapidité et l'énergie concrète qui ont mené ValPay jusqu'ici.

Nous recrutons pour le potentiel. Ce poste est défini aujourd'hui comme celui de chef de l'ingénierie, et il est conçu comme la voie d'accès possible au poste de chef de la technologie (CTO) chez ValPay. Nous préférons embaucher une personne ayant la capacité de croître vers ce rôle et l'appuyer pleinement, plutôt que d'embaucher un titre en espérant que cela fonctionne. Les conditions de cette progression sont claires : une organisation de livraison qui fonctionne sans héroïsme, un banc de leaders que vous aurez bâti, et un jugement technique sur lequel la direction et le conseil peuvent s'appuyer.

CE QUE VOUS FEREZ

Assumer la livraison en ingénierie de bout en bout — planification, exécution, cadence de mise en production et qualité — et la rendre suffisamment prévisible pour que l'entreprise puisse planifier en conséquence.
Bâtir et diriger la couche de gestion en ingénierie : embaucher, développer et encadrer des gestionnaires de l'ingénierie, des chefs techniques et des ingénieurs seniors ou principaux, et mettre en place une structure durable sous votre responsabilité.
Collaborer avec le Produit sur la faisabilité, le séquencement et les compromis de la feuille de route. Le Produit définit le quoi; vous êtes responsable du comment et du quand.
Définir et faire respecter les normes techniques de la plateforme — architecture, qualité du code, tests, observabilité et documentation — afin que le système évolue avec la croissance du volume de paiements et du nombre de marchands.
Agir comme point d'escalade technique senior pour les intégrations avec les principaux partenaires de paiement (Adyen, Fiserv), en menant les enjeux complexes jusqu'à leur résolution et en réinjectant les apprentissages dans la plateforme.
Piloter l'adoption de l'IA au sein de l'ingénierie — dans le cycle de développement, dans la productivité des développeurs et dans le produit lorsque les bénéfices sont mesurables.
Assumer les opérations d'ingénierie et la fiabilité : garde, réponse aux incidents, post-mortems et niveaux de service qu'exige une plateforme de paiement certifiée PCI DSS de niveau 1.
Collaborer avec les équipes de sécurité et de conformité afin de maintenir la certification PCI DSS et les obligations multijuridictionnelles à mesure que la plateforme s'étend.
Demeurer une présence stable sous pression et développer la capacité organisationnelle permettant à l'équipe de gérer les incidents de plus en plus sans vous.

CE QUE VOUS APPORTEZ

Au moins 8 ans d'expérience en génie logiciel, dont 4 ans ou plus à diriger des équipes d'ingénierie, incluant une période de gestion de gestionnaires ou de chefs techniques.
Expérience démontrée dans la création, la structuration et la mise à l'échelle d'organisations technologiques, idéalement dans des environnements à forte croissance.
Expérience d'embauche et de développement de leaders en ingénierie, et le désir de continuer à le faire.
Vous conservez une profondeur technique concrète et applicable : vous révisez l'architecture, vous pouvez approfondir une revue de conception ou un incident, et les ingénieurs respectent votre jugement. L'écriture de code en production au quotidien n'est pas attendue.
Un jugement solide sur les décisions de type « développer ou acheter », sur la dette technique et sur l'allocation de la capacité d'ingénierie — et la capacité d'expliquer ces choix en termes d'affaires à une équipe de direction non technique.
Un historique démontré d'implantation de processus de livraison dans une équipe qui avance vite, sans en freiner la rapidité : cadence de planification, discipline de mise en production, garde, et les indicateurs permettant d'en mesurer l'efficacit

jobs.description:
Are you ready to embark on a career that truly affects people around the world? Trulioo invites you to be a catalyst for change in the dynamic realm of digital identity verification. As the global front-runner in our industry, we are redefining how businesses grow, innovate and comply online.

Picture yourself at the forefront of innovation, contributing to our award-winning platform that enables organizations worldwide to quickly onboard customers, optimize costs and combat fraud. Fueled by Silicon Valley support, Trulioo stands as the trusted platform that can verify more than 5 billion people and 700 million business entities spanning 195 countries.

But Trulioo is more than a tech company. We are a united force of dedicated experts committed to establishing trust online - and we’re proud to be recognized as a BC Top Employer for the second consecutive year
, reflecting our commitment to an inclusive, collaborative, and people-first workplace.

Headquartered in Vancouver and with strategic hubs in San Diego and Dublin, we foster a culture of collaboration and open communication. Our offices support a hybrid model and staff typically work three days per week at a hub location. Join us where excitement meets innovation and contribute to a world where trust and technology unite.

What We Offer

Comprehensive Benefits: We provide a robust benefits package for full-time, permanent employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plans with company match, paid time off, parental leave, and an annual education & training stipend (equivalent to $1,000 in local currency). Specific benefits may vary by location and will be discussed further during the interview process.
Flexible Hybrid Working Environment: Our offices are designed to support both collaboration and flexibility. Enjoy weekly lunches, quality coffee, and regular social events. Many locations also feature parent rooms, on-site gyms, comfortable lounges, and adaptable workstations to support your comfort and productivity.
Wellness: We care about your well-being. Team members have access to wellness workshops and events, as well as a complimentary Headspace subscription to help you stay focused, grounded, and energized.
Employee Resource Groups: Belonging is an important part of doing your best work. Our ERGs provide an inclusive space, support and community for employees of diverse backgrounds and allies. We host informative, fun sessions and celebrations that are often open to the entire organization.

Position Summary

The Chief of Staff at Trulioo is a critical leadership role that drives strategic alignment, operational execution, and organizational effectiveness at the highest levels of the company. Acting as a trusted advisor and right-hand to the CEO, you will ensure that executive priorities are translated into action, internal processes are optimized, and cross-functional collaboration is seamless.

You will work closely with the CEO and the executive team, serving as a thought partner, problem-solver, and operational lead across a wide array of strategic initiatives. This role requires exceptional judgment, discretion, communication, and project management capabilities. The ideal candidate brings a blend of strategic thinking, execution excellence, and operational rigor, paired with the humility and flexibility to operate both behind the scenes and in leadership settings.

A defining part of this role is AI fluency: you will be the executive team’s go-to person for identifying where AI tools can remove friction, accelerate decisions, and free up leadership time and you’ll model that adoption yourself before asking others to follow.

This is a full-time position available on either a permanent or fixed-term basis, with a preference for a permanent hire. Remote work may be considered for the right candidate

What You’ll Be Doing

Set and sustain the operating rhythm. Own executive meetings, business reviews, board meetings, and offsites, including agendas, pre-reads, decisions, and follow-through. Ensure everyone leaves clear on what was decided and who owns it.
Run the goal-setting system. Own the OKR process end-to-end, and give the CEO and leadership team an honest read on where the business actually stands.
Prepare the CEO for high-stakes moments. Build board materials, executive presentations, and briefings for critical internal and external meetings.
Lead what nobody owns. Find the gaps, lead the cross-functional initiatives that fill them, then hand them off cleanly. Expect two or three running at a time, including initiatives to identify, pilot, and roll out AI tools that streamline internal processes across teams.
Extend the CEO's reach. Shape communications for town halls, company updates, and speaking engagements. Stand in for the CEO where appropriate, knowing what to decide and what to bring back.
Be a candid thought partner. Help the CEO prioritize and pressure-test decisions.
Champion AI adoption across the executive team. Act as the internal evangelist and coach for practical AI use, identifying high-value use cases, vetting new tools, running lightweight trainings, and helping executives build AI-augmented habits into their own workflows.

What You’ll Bring

5+ years of experience in executive operations, management consulting, corporate strategy, project management, or business operations, preferably within a fast-paced tech or SaaS environment.
Proven experience supporting C-level executives or founders in a Chief of Staff, Business Manager, or Strategic Advisor role.
Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to connect the dots and drive clarity across complexity.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to craft high-impact executive communications.
Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously under tight deadlines.
High EQ and interpersonal intelligence - able to influence, mediate, and build trust across all levels of the organization.
Absolute discretion and professionalism in handling sensitive and confidential information.

Interview Process

At Trulioo, we strive to create an interview experience that is transparent, engaging, and respectful of your time. Our process is designed to help us learn more about your skills and experience while giving you insight into our team, culture, and the impact of the work we do.

Here's What You Can Expect Throughout The Interview Process

Recruiter Interview: 30-minutes
Hiring Manager Interview: 45-minutes
Follow-Up Interview: 45-Minutes
Leadership Interview: 45-minutes
Final Interview: 60-minutes

Thriving at Trulioo

At Trulioo, you’re not just an employee. You’re a valued member of our Trulicrew on a journey of professional and personal growth with a world-class organization. With Trulioo, you have the power to revolutionize the intersection of technology, digital trust and online identity to open the global economy to everyone. Together, we can shape the digital future.

We’re on the lookout for exceptional people to empower with trust, autonomy and the freedom to cultivate their potential. Your curiosity, meticulous attention to detail and passion to contribute are highly valued. If that resonates with you, apply today to become a part of our team. Join us in shaping a future where your career isn’t just a journey but also a boundless exploration into the possibilities of technology and digital identity verification.

Get an inside look at life at Trulioo by following us on LinkedIn, or learn more about us at www.trulioo.com

If you don’t see yourself fully reflected in every job requirement listed on the posting above, we still encourage you to reach out and apply. Description

ABOUT VALPAY

Founded in 2022, ValPay is an all-in-one payment solution tailored to empower its partners' software platforms. Designed for ambitious business owners wanting to focus on growing their business rather than the logistics needed to run it, ValPay helps companies prevent fraud, gain access to real-time reporting, and accept both online and in-person payments. ValPay's PayFac-as-a-Service model gives its partners all the benefits of integrated payments while handling the heavy lifting.

ValPay is a subsidiary of Valsoft.

THE ROLE

As Head of Engineering, you will own the engineering organization at ValPay — how it is structured, how it delivers, and how good it gets. You will report to the CEO and work alongside product and go-to-market leadership to turn a talented, lean team into a predictable, high-performing engineering function.

This is a build role, not a caretaker role. ValPay's engineering team has grown quickly and now needs someone to put real operating discipline behind it: a delivery rhythm people can count on, a management layer that holds, and technical standards that let the platform scale with the business — without losing the speed and hands-on energy that got ValPay here.

We are hiring for trajectory. This role is scoped as Head of Engineering today, and it is designed as the potential path to Chief Technology Officer at ValPay. We would rather hire someone with the ceiling to grow into that seat and back them properly than hire the title and hope. What earns the step up is straightforward: a delivery organization that runs without heroics, a leadership bench you built, and a track record of technical judgment the CEO and the board can lean on.

What You'll Do

Own engineering delivery end to end — planning, execution, release cadence, and quality — and make it predictable enough that the business can plan around it.
Build and lead the engineering management layer: hire, develop, and coach engineering managers, tech leads, and senior/staff engineers, and put a durable structure beneath you.
Partner with Product on roadmap feasibility, sequencing, and trade-offs. Product sets the what; you own the how and the when.
Set and enforce technical standards across the platform — architecture, code quality, testing, observability, and documentation — so the system scales as GMV and merchant count grow.
Serve as the senior technical escalation point for integrations with core payments partners (Adyen, Fiserv), working complex issues to resolution and feeding what you learn back into the platform.
Drive AI adoption inside engineering — in the SDLC, in developer productivity, and in the product where it measurably improves outcomes.
Own engineering operations and reliability: on-call, incident response, postmortems, and the SLAs a PCI DSS Level 1 payments platform has to hold.
Partner with security and compliance to keep PCI DSS certification and multi-jurisdiction obligations met as the platform expands.
Be a steady presence under pressure, and build the organizational muscle for the team to handle incidents increasingly without you.

What You Bring

8+ years in software engineering, including 4+ years leading engineering teams, with at least some of that time managing managers or tech leads.
Proven experience building, structuring, and scaling technology organizations, ideally in high-growth environments.
Experience hiring and developing engineering leaders, and the appetite to keep doing it.
You can still apply hands-on technical depth, you review architecture, you can go deep in a design review or an incident, and engineers respect your judgment. You are not expected to write production code day to day.
Strong judgment on build-versus-buy, technical debt, and where to spend engineering capacity — and the ability to explain those calls in business terms to a non-technical executive team.
A track record of installing delivery process in a fast-moving team without killing its speed: planning cadence, release discipline, on-call, and the metrics to know whether it is working.
Demonstrable ambition and ceiling. You want the CTO seat eventually and you can show what you have been doing to get ready for it.

NICE TO HAVE

Payments, fintech, or other regulated/high-availability environments (PCI DSS, SOC 2, or similar).

Experience in a high-growth or private-equity-backed environment, or integrating engineering teams from acquisitions.

Experience with multi-tenant platform or API-first product architecture.

What Success Looks Like

In the first six to twelve months:

A management layer is in place: engineering managers or tech leads owning their areas, with clear scope and accountability.
Engineering runs on a delivery rhythm the business can plan against — commitments are made and met, and slippage is visible early rather than at the deadline.
Delivery and reliability are measured, not felt — baseline metrics exist for throughput, lead time, change failure rate, and incident response, and they are trending the right way.
AI is in real use inside engineering, with live use cases rather than pilots.
On-call and incident response are defined and drilled, and incidents are increasingly resolved without you in the room.
Technical standards and architecture direction are written down, agreed, and actually followed.

WHY VALPAY

Founded in 2022, ValPay is already operating at scale: a PCI DSS Level 1 certified platform running across 40+ jurisdictions in North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific, serving vertical software platforms in dental, marine, property management, automotive, and more.

Growth runs on three engines, and all three run on the same platform:

Internal sales — converting existing Valsoft GMV to ValPay, a $15B+ opportunity across the current customer base plus every new Valsoft acquisition.
External ISV channel — signing ISVs outside the Valsoft portfolio, $25M–$50M in revenue, with $2B+ in deals already closed and now being converted into live, processing merchants.
M&A engine — acquiring payment gateway businesses, two closed so far, with the same conversion playbook applied to each newly acquired asset.

Embedded payments inside a portfolio of 150+ vertical software companies is distribution most payments companies spend years trying to build. ValPay already has it. What decides how fast these engines scale is the engineering organization behind them — which is the mandate of this role.

ValPay is backed by Valsoft, which buys and holds companies indefinitely rather than selling them. You build on a long horizon, not toward an exit.

For more information: https://www.valpay.com/

___________________________________________________________________________________________

À PROPOS DE VALPAY

Fondée en 2022, ValPay est une solution de paiement tout-en-un conçue pour outiller les plateformes logicielles de ses partenaires. Pensée pour les entrepreneurs ambitieux qui souhaitent se consacrer à la croissance de leur entreprise plutôt qu'à la logistique nécessaire à son exploitation, ValPay aide les entreprises à prévenir la fraude, à accéder à des rapports en temps réel et à accepter les paiements en ligne comme en personne. Le modèle de facilitation des paiements en tant que service (PayFac-as-a-Service) de ValPay procure à ses partenaires tous les avantages des paiements intégrés, tout en prenant en charge le gros du travail.

ValPay est une filiale de Valsoft.

LE POSTE

À titre de chef de l'ingénierie, vous prendrez en charge l'organisation d'ingénierie de ValPay : sa structure, sa capacité de livraison et son niveau d'excellence. Vous relèverez du chef de la direction et travaillerez aux côtés des responsables du produit et de la mise en marché afin de transformer une équipe talentueuse et restreinte en une fonction d'ingénierie prévisible et très performante.

Il s'agit d'un rôle de bâtisseur, et non de gestionnaire de statu quo. L'équipe d'ingénierie de ValPay a connu une croissance rapide et a maintenant besoin d'une personne capable d'y instaurer une véritable discipline opérationnelle : une cadence de livraison fiable, une couche de gestion solide et des normes techniques permettant à la plateforme d'évoluer au rythme de l'entreprise — sans perdre la rapidité et l'énergie concrète qui ont mené ValPay jusqu'ici.

Nous recrutons pour le potentiel. Ce poste est défini aujourd'hui comme celui de chef de l'ingénierie, et il est conçu comme la voie d'accès possible au poste de chef de la technologie (CTO) chez ValPay. Nous préférons embaucher une personne ayant la capacité de croître vers ce rôle et l'appuyer pleinement, plutôt que d'embaucher un titre en espérant que cela fonctionne. Les conditions de cette progression sont claires : une organisation de livraison qui fonctionne sans héroïsme, un banc de leaders que vous aurez bâti, et un jugement technique sur lequel la direction et le conseil peuvent s'appuyer.

CE QUE VOUS FEREZ

Assumer la livraison en ingénierie de bout en bout — planification, exécution, cadence de mise en production et qualité — et la rendre suffisamment prévisible pour que l'entreprise puisse planifier en conséquence.
Bâtir et diriger la couche de gestion en ingénierie : embaucher, développer et encadrer des gestionnaires de l'ingénierie, des chefs techniques et des ingénieurs seniors ou principaux, et mettre en place une structure durable sous votre responsabilité.
Collaborer avec le Produit sur la faisabilité, le séquencement et les compromis de la feuille de route. Le Produit définit le quoi; vous êtes responsable du comment et du quand.
Définir et faire respecter les normes techniques de la plateforme — architecture, qualité du code, tests, observabilité et documentation — afin que le système évolue avec la croissance du volume de paiements et du nombre de marchands.
Agir comme point d'escalade technique senior pour les intégrations avec les principaux partenaires de paiement (Adyen, Fiserv), en menant les enjeux complexes jusqu'à leur résolution et en réinjectant les apprentissages dans la plateforme.
Piloter l'adoption de l'IA au sein de l'ingénierie — dans le cycle de développement, dans la productivité des développeurs et dans le produit lorsque les bénéfices sont mesurables.
Assumer les opérations d'ingénierie et la fiabilité : garde, réponse aux incidents, post-mortems et niveaux de service qu'exige une plateforme de paiement certifiée PCI DSS de niveau 1.
Collaborer avec les équipes de sécurité et de conformité afin de maintenir la certification PCI DSS et les obligations multijuridictionnelles à mesure que la plateforme s'étend.
Demeurer une présence stable sous pression et développer la capacité organisationnelle permettant à l'équipe de gérer les incidents de plus en plus sans vous.

CE QUE VOUS APPORTEZ

Au moins 8 ans d'expérience en génie logiciel, dont 4 ans ou plus à diriger des équipes d'ingénierie, incluant une période de gestion de gestionnaires ou de chefs techniques.
Expérience démontrée dans la création, la structuration et la mise à l'échelle d'organisations technologiques, idéalement dans des environnements à forte croissance.
Expérience d'embauche et de développement de leaders en ingénierie, et le désir de continuer à le faire.
Vous conservez une profondeur technique concrète et applicable : vous révisez l'architecture, vous pouvez approfondir une revue de conception ou un incident, et les ingénieurs respectent votre jugement. L'écriture de code en production au quotidien n'est pas attendue.
Un jugement solide sur les décisions de type « développer ou acheter », sur la dette technique et sur l'allocation de la capacité d'ingénierie — et la capacité d'expliquer ces choix en termes d'affaires à une équipe de direction non technique.
Un historique démontré d'implantation de processus de livraison dans une équipe qui avance vite, sans en freiner la rapidité : cadence de planification, discipline de mise en production, garde, et les indicateurs permettant d'en mesurer l'efficacit
